meta.title: System usage
meta.description: Shows the CPU and memory load of the machine running DeepSeek Harness in the left sidebar, directly above Settings on its own full-width row. CPU and MEM sit side by side, each with a percentage and a short bar; the row above keeps the existing footer actions. Hover or focus for the device name, core count, load average, memory used and total, the DSH process footprint, and the sample time, and click for a fresh sample. A Host route samples the machine every two seconds while the page is visible, reads no Session data, and sends nothing off the machine. The readout is hidden while the sidebar is collapsed to its 56px rail. Turning the bundle off removes the row and stops the route.
